department: Doctoral Program in Chemistry and Chemical Engineering (EDCH)

deadline.value: Three rounds a year: January 15, April 30 and September 15. Next for Fall 2027: January 15, 2027 (year inferred).
deadline.quote: Deadlines: Submission prior to January 15, April 30 or September 15.

supervisor.value: A thesis supervisor (lab) must be found; enrolment is conditional on a supervisor and secure funding.
supervisor.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

funding.value: Enrolment requires secure funding, so admitted students are funded (typically as salaried EPFL doctoral assistants).
funding.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

also.quote: The basic starting salary of an EPFL doctoral assistant is CHF 55’225.- gross per annum

entry_route.value: Doctoral studies usually begin after a master's; 4- or 5-year bachelor's holders may apply and should explain their education.
entry_route.quote: Doctoral studies at EPFL usually begin after a Master’s degree in the relevant discipline. | Candidates with a 4-year or 5-year Bachelor’s degree may also apply

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: Covers chemical engineering too. 4-year program taught in English.
